learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and abilities for the calculation, design, and testing of machines.

Ability for the drafting and development of projects in the field of mechanical engineering, for the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or exploitation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Ability to perform measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Ability to manage specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to interpret projects and technical reports.
Ability to evaluate the effectiveness, feasibility, and quality of implemented solutions.
Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Acquire the ability to solve problems effectively.
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within its field of application.
Possess the ability to make decisions.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Ability to apply knowledge to practice.
Acquire the capacity for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.

teaching_methods: Theoretical classes (multimedia projector and/or blackboard exposition)

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment of theory and laboratory practices

assessment_rules: For the first and second calls, assessment consists of continuous assessment of theory and laboratory practices (20%), a written test of theoretical-practical questions (40%), and a written problems test (40%). A minimum mark of 20% is required for each part. For the second call, the continuous assessment part becomes a theory and laboratory practices test. Exceptional evaluation comprises a theoretical-practical test (40%), a problems test (40%), and a personal project (20%), with a minimum mark of 20% on each part.
